resources.allowTrivial: The first load publishes entries 1; only three further enters of the same scene publish 4.
Both real normalized GLBs reload and finish before every observation, including the fourth enter's.
A texture image on each reloaded GLB is counted before the observation.
The renderer's live geometry tally is only published once the settle window has measured a settled one; how many a backend initialises for this scene is its own business.
The exit path's disposal is what makes a re-entry's settled tally return to the first enter's settled tally, and only a leak can move the difference between them.
The renderer's live texture tally is only published once the settle window has measured a settled one, which is after the KTX2 and panel textures have landed.
The exit path's disposal is what makes a re-entry's settled tally return to the first enter's settled tally, and only a leak can move the difference between them.
